title: You're Nobody 'til Somebody Loves You
lyrics_plain:
You're nobody 'til somebody loves you
You're nobody 'til somebody cares

You may be the king, you may possess
The world and it's gold
Ah, but gold won't bring you happiness
A-when you're growing real old-a

The world still is the same
You'll never change it
As sure as the stars, shine above
Oh, you're nobody 'til somebody really loves you
So find yourself somebody to love

(The world still is the same)
(You'll never change it)
As sure as the stars, shine above
Oh, you're nobody 'til somebody loves you
So find yourself somebody to love
